_README: Campus Student Affairs and Services Office, extracted from the PUP Citizen's Charter 2025 Edition (External Services, printed pp. 663-733). effective_from 2025-01-01 is an ASSUMPTION (edition year start); replace if the Charter prints an effective date. Each service lists transaction_types (all listed). Standards carry the three-part duration (duration_days, duration_hours, duration_minutes). See CCMS_SEEDING_INSTRUCTIONS_10062026.md section 5.3. Review before importing. Each service also carries service_scope (INTERNAL or EXTERNAL, from the Charter section it was printed in); see CCMS_SEEDING_INSTRUCTIONS_10062026.md section 7. UPDATED 10/21/2026 (Decision D1): the 12 services that also appear in the Admissions and Registrations Office Charter (PUP-OSAS-ADM-001 to 004, CRD-001 to 004, CRD-006, GRD-001 to 003) were removed from this file; they are now in CCMS_SEED_ADMREG_10212026.json and CCMS_SEED_REG_10212026.json (Correction of Name is PUP-REG-GRD-001 there, with a TEMPORARY total of 6 days 7 hours 1 minute taken from the old copy in this file until the Registrar confirms). 8 services remain (from 20). PUP-OSAS-CRD-005 stays reserved for the held EXT.18.

services.service_name: Request for Certificate of Good Moral Character
services.processing_steps:
Step 1. Secure and fill-out the application form accordingly (Form PUP- ACGM-5-OFSS-0007) Location: Polytechnic University of the Philippines
  1. Check the form [Responsible: Students/Alumni]
Step 2. Pay appropriate fee at the Cashier's Office Location: Polytechnic University of the Philippines
  2. Receive the payment and issue official receipt [Responsible: Collection Officer Cashier's Office]
Step 3. Proceed to the Head of Student Affairs and Services for the processing and issuance of the certificate Location: Polytechnic University of the Philippines
  3. Print and issue the certificate of good moral character [Responsible: Head of Student Affairs and Services]
Step 4. Sign in the logbook provided for the purpose Location: Polytechnic University of the Philippines
  4. Require the student/alumni to sign in the logbook [Responsible: Head of Students Affairs and Services]
